gang_lens: Red vs blue as the spine. Cain's crew rolls red, Abel's side is blue. Nephilim wear black - a merger of red, blue, and Latino sets (green) that used to fight each other. Latino sets assigned green.
standing_rules: Every character gets one anchor detail that never changes across episodes
Expressions must map to specific story beats for each character
Urban Black cast baseline - braids, dreads, afros, fades, half-dreads
All sheeted characters trace through Seth's line and wear blue rags by default
Nephilim (black) are the only ones not on the main line
Physical fallout from disobedience must be visible in the body
Bible reference shown in small text or closing card - translation, not rewrite
